decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the top-rated bag options in the feed, but found them to be too specialized for my needs. The consideration set included a mesh school bag (prod_backpacks_128), a baseball-specific bag (prod_backpacks_122), a tactical gun case (prod_backpacks_059), a fishing gear pack (prod_backpacks_160), and a small sling (prod_backpacks_159). While these products are well-reviewed within their respective niches, the feed lacked a high-quality, general-purpose daily backpack. Additionally, over half of the product feed consisted of irrelevant accessories like cooking utensils, lanterns, and freeze-dried food, making for a poor browsing experience. Consequently, I decided to not make a purchase during this session.
